items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I worked opposite Chick's band up there while I was with Willie Bryant.

ctx.x: I heard that some guys were just turned off by his bragging. Is that true?
I don't think so, because fellas used to sit around and egg Jelly on, they used to love to hear him argue-- brag like that, you know, and he and Chick Webb used

to get into the darnedest arguments you ever heard and the guys used to sit around there and just egg him on and he would go. So anyway, Jelly said 'Where can I get a drummer?' Well the musicians around the club didn't know me by name, they just said there's a kid over there I think plays drums. So he came over and approached me, 'Do you play drums?' I says yeah. 'Who'd you ever work with?' That's when I started lying you know, because God, Jelly Roll Morton, I'd been reading about him, I looked at Jelly, I said,…
